title: Health screening module returns to the University of Warwick this autumn

content.text: The health screening module is running again this autumn at the University of Warwick from Monday 16 November to Friday 20 November.
The module is delivered by Warwick Medical School, with input from the UK National Screening Committee (UK NSC) secretariat team and NHS England colleagues.
The intensive 5-day course covers screening epidemiology, ethics, and policy, with teaching from experts. It is suitable for those who commission, run, or evaluate screening programmes.
Visit the University of Warwick’s Health Screening module page to find out more and to apply.
For questions about the course, contact pgt-portfolio3@warwick.ac.uk.
